newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Summer in Austrian Tyrol ploughs into snow.
newsitem.headline: Summer in Austrian Tyrol ploughs into snow.

text.p: Western Austria received an unseasonal blanket of snow with up to 40 cm (16 inches) falling over the weekend in the Alpine state of Tyrol, the Innsbruck weather service said on Monday.

The snow wreaked havoc in certain parts of Tyrol, triggering landslides and floods. It centred on the glacial areas of the Oetz and Ziller valleys, with the snow line edging down as low as 1,374 metres (4,500 feet), the weather service said.
